audit_question_answers.1: Yes, the P2-capable trainer can consume the P4-B R1 regenerated full dataset without changing Reason Router scientific semantics only after authority-approved identity rebinding and a current-lineage sidecar/equivalent metadata artifact; at audit_state_commit it cannot consume it because fail-fast constants reject non-historical data/sidecar identities.
audit_question_answers.2: Historical f552.../5bc... bindings remain in _STAGE187_AUTHORITATIVE_DATA, _STAGE187_DATASET_SHA256, _STAGE187_AUTHORITATIVE_SIDECAR, _STAGE187_SIDECAR_SEMANTIC_SHA256, _stage187_load_integrity_sidecar, _p2_load_reason_integrity_sidecar, Stage191/193/195 preflight checks, checkpoint metadata, provenance/manifest fields, and historical P3 A0 reference-audit expected fields.
audit_question_answers.3: Artifacts 8-10 are not sufficient as a complete A0 metadata/supervision bridge. They prove scoped predicate-realization compatibility and non-mutation of Stage185-v1 observations, but not full-dataset row-order/source_dataset_sha/split/sidecar semantic integrity required by the trainer.
audit_question_answers.4: Yes. A new current-lineage effective integrity sidecar or equivalent deterministic compatibility artifact bound to the regenerated dataset is required before A0 can run.
audit_question_answers.5: The derived artifact's purpose is to provide P2/A0 metadata and reason-supervision integrity over the regenerated full dataset, with minimum input identity of the P4-B R1 regenerated dataset SHA256 eb1e..., semantic SHA256 3797..., P4-B artifacts 8-10, and immutable historical Stage185-v1 evidence as historical input only.
audit_question_answers.6: Minimal future delta is a current-lineage dataset/sidecar identity rebind in constants, loader checks, manifest/provenance fields, checkpoint metadata, and A0 reference-audit expected fields, plus preserving fail-fast row/order/source_dataset_sha/split/semantic SHA gates.
audit_question_answers.7: Historical P3 A0 execution parameters are not current-lineage execution authority. A separate future parameter authority is required before A0 execution.
audit_question_answers.8: At audit_state_commit the source paths reject regenerated substitution rather than silently consuming it. Historical malformed-F2 semantics would remain reachable only through unrebound historical dataset/sidecar path or source_dataset_sha checks in a future patch.
audit_question_answers.9: Yes. A0 can remain scientifically identical after provenance rebinding because the required delta is identity/provenance/loader/manifest binding only and does not require changing router mode, reason order, gradient ownership, final CE ownership, secondary-reason diagnostics, EMA, A0-A3, or E0.
